Checking webhook.go to locate the outbound delivery function and its protection against internal network addresses.

Also examining the memo and user service webhook files to understand delivery and SSRF protection.

The outbound HTTP POST executes in the `Post()` function within `internal/webhook/webhook.go`.

Delivery runs asynchronously through worker goroutines in `init()` that invoke `Post(payload)` from the async queue via `PostAsync()`.

Protection against internal network addresses comes from `safeDialContext` and `isReservedIP` in `webhook.go` and `validate.go`, plus `reservedCIDRs` checks in `validate.go`. `ValidateURL` blocks registration of unsafe URLs, and `safeClient` uses a transport with `safeDialContext` at dial time.

The answer should list `Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` as the delivery function, and `safeDialContext` in `internal/webhook/validate.go` as the protection mechanism.

The exact answer is still being weighed between `safeDialContext` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` and `isReservedIP` / `reservedCIDRs` in `internal/webhook/validate.go`.
Checking user_service_webhooks for ValidateURL usage during registration.

Outbound delivery executes in `Post()` at line 152 via `safeClient.Do(req)`.

`safeDialContext` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` guards against internal addresses by re-resolving DNS at dial time to prevent SSRF. `isReservedIP` in `internal/validate.go` defines the reserved CIDR ranges checked during registration.

`safeDialContext` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` re-resolves DNS at dial time to block private IPs. `isReservedIP` in `internal/webhook/validate.go` defines the reserved CIDR ranges. `ValidateURL` in `internal/validate.go` blocks invalid URLs at registration time.

h02.

**Post — internal/webhook/webhook.go; safeDialContext — internal/webhook/webhook.go**

Outbound HTTP delivery runs in `Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go`), which issues the POST via `safeClient.Do(req)` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:152`). Callers enqueue work with `PostAsync` (e.g. `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:71`); background workers in `init()` drain that queue and call `Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-54`).

Protection against internal/reserved addresses is enforced at connection time by `safeDialContext`, wired into `safeClient`’s `http.Transport` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:32-36`, `57-77`). It resolves the target host and rejects any IP in reserved/private ranges via `isReservedIP` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:43-54`), which checks against `reservedCIDRs` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:14-23`). URLs are also validated at create/update time with `ValidateURL` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:56-83`), and that check can be bypassed with the `allow-private-webhooks` flag (`internal/webhook/validate.go:38-41`, set in `cmd/memos/main.go:49`).
